name: no-torsion-old
description: Legacy Express plus EJS frontend extracted from No-Torsion.

scripts.test: FRONTEND_VARIANT=legacy node --test tests/app.test.js tests/standaloneFormApp.test.js tests/workerResponse.test.mjs tests/nctBackendProxy.test.js tests/nctBackendService.test.js
scripts.deploy:workers: npm run cf:ensure && npx wrangler deploy --keep-vars
scripts.deploy:workers:preview: npm run cf:ensure && npx wrangler versions upload
scripts.deploy:workers:standalone-form: npm run cf:ensure:standalone-form && npx wrangler deploy -c standalone/form-worker/wrangler.jsonc --keep-vars
scripts.deploy:workers:standalone-form:preview: npm run cf:ensure:standalone-form && npx wrangler versions upload -c standalone/form-worker/wrangler.jsonc
